test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The selling price of an iPhone is ₹3,300, after allowing two successive discounts of 36% and 25%. Find the marked price of the iPhone.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive discounts ⇒ net factor = (1 − 0.36)(1 − 0.25)

⇒ 0.64 × 0.75 = 0.48

SP = 0.48 × MP = 3300

⇒ MP = 3300 ÷ 0.48 = 6875

**∴ Answer = 6875**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling price = 3300

Discounts = 36% and 25%

**Formula used:**

Final price = MP × (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = MP × (1 − 36/100) × (1 − 25/100)

⇒ 3300 = MP × (64/100) × (75/100)

⇒ 3300 = MP × (48/100)

⇒ MP = 3300 × 100 ÷ 48

⇒ MP = 6875

**∴ The correct answer is 6875.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Net factor = (1 − d₁)(1 − d₂)

Shortcut

Multiply remaining percentages directly.

Reverse Calculation

MP = SP ÷ net factor
